scope: Before viewing any outcome from job 15227; qualitative qualification rubric, not a new numerical stopping rule.
estimand: Diagnostic-first policy versus freely chosen inspection/improvement, with common tools, time and call caps. Not an isolated causal effect of observation content.
denominator: All eight scheduled trajectories and all generated actions, including rejected format, timeout, incorrect diagnosis, no change and invalid repairs.
questions_for_every_diagnostic: Were distinct explanations linked to distinct edits before execution?
Was a provisional edit and an observation-dependent decision rule stated before execution?
Did executable code measure real public-data/program behaviour rather than print assumed conclusions?
Did the check actually return, and were failure/uncertainty visible to the subsequent call?
Do the next rationale AND actual code follow the observed result? A citation to a log alone is insufficient.
Did the edit differ from the pre-check provisional choice? If unknown or unchanged, do not claim decision-changing evidence.
Is this outside the shared known fixes, and distinct from simply reproducing a cheap classical reference?
Did the repaired candidate execute and improve the external exploratory development metric over the common incumbent?
Did the complete diagnostic-first trajectory improve over the paired ordinary trajectory, including all diagnostic cost?
negative_and_control_cases: Ordinary arm spontaneously inspecting the same issue reduces treatment separation; it does not show diagnostics are useless.
No final-score harm from retaining the incumbent is shared baseline behaviour, not a new benefit.
Format or token-cap failures are feasibility failures under this interface, not proof that the conceptual method cannot work.
A measured contrast between differently coded pipelines may include multiple changes; do not infer a single cause.
A repair outside the two explicit known rules is not automatically a novel ML method.
Repeated identical code or predictions across seeds are disclosed, not counted as independent discoveries.

Actions use fresh workspaces and pass observations/code but not fitted artifacts; this shared interface can be particularly costly for fit-heavy diagnostics. A failure here is not a universal test of artifact-reusing diagnosis.
The two explanations and decision rule are part of the policy treatment. If A also chooses CHECK, this is not a diagnosis-versus-no-diagnosis comparison.
Equal limits do not imply equal realized token/execution cost. Report actual completions, execution and full GPU allocation rather than silently credit unused caps as savings.
Only two generation seeds per task and one reused starting program per task: the numerical gate qualifies further study, not statistical significance or independent confirmation.
no_posthoc_tuning: Do not change prompts, add seeds, change tasks, inspect protected cohorts, or launch follow-up fits in response to one favourable action.
novelty: Not cleared. MLToolBench, AgentX-Model, Gome and other documented neighbours already cover diagnostic evidence and decision use. A positive pilot is only grounds for a narrower study, not a top-venue claim.
prospective_gate: Original plan remains authoritative: positive paired-gain median on both tasks plus real new evidence-to-repair mechanism. Qualitative uncertainty is retained. Two seeds on reused development data cannot establish significance or fresh-test transfer.
